minimum_required_semantics.crustal_material: An explicit physical bulk composition/material family (and scope) is a legitimate minimal authorial primitive; land/ocean labels are not enough. Do not author density or phase-state independently when derived by the selected material specialist.
minimum_required_semantics.tectonic_process: No global ridge/subduction/collision/transform classification is required for the minimum connected-continuum ShellSet mechanics path based on reviewed evidence.
minimum_required_semantics.thermal_initialization: An explicitly selected thermal model family and its driving boundary/material inputs are required; no model, parameter, or value is selected in this report.
minimum_required_semantics.elevation: Complete modeled surface elevation support remains a legitimate independent world-geometry primitive; canonical land elevation is retained, ocean support remains unresolved.
minimum_required_semantics.rheology: Specialist model configuration, separate from WORLD_HISTORY state; no parameters selected. Material classes may later inform grouping but do not determine rheology automatically.

crustal_material_requirements.minimum_authorial_input: Physical bulk composition/material family semantics, with explicit spatial scope and provenance.

material_class_vs_property_analysis.material_class: Authorial semantic describing composition/assemblage family and where it applies.
material_class_vs_property_analysis.material_properties: Specialist-derived outputs conditional on material class, P/T, EOS/database and solution models.

Perple_X.role: Phase-equilibrium petrology from bulk composition and selected thermodynamic database/solution models; can provide equilibrium phase assemblages and aggregate properties including volume/density under P-T conditions.
inputs: Bulk composition expressible in database components
outputs: Stable phase assemblage/fractions and aggregate thermodynamic properties, subject to chosen models
Perple_X.integration: Fortran program suite, principally configured/file-driven workflows; no official Python API identified in audited documentation. Batch orchestration would require controlled input/output adapters.
Perple_X.license_runtime: Current license/integration terms require verification against the selected release. Official site documents platform executables and source/build workflow; source availability alone is not a license determination.

BurnMan.role: Thermoelastic/mineral-physics property evaluation for specified mineral/endmember/solution assemblages; phase-equilibrium tools exist when the phase/reaction system is configured.
inputs: Pressure in Pa and temperature in K
outputs: Density/volume and thermoelastic properties conditional on the selected EOS and material model
BurnMan.integration: Python library; repeatable point/profile evaluation can be orchestrated in Python, subject to pinned versions/data and reproducibility controls.
BurnMan.license_runtime: Official repository/docs identify GPL-2.0-or-later. Runtime/data dependencies and compatible license review remain necessary before integration.

composition_density_specialists.role_decision: Do not select one winner yet. If equilibrium phase petrology from bulk composition is required, Perple_X is the more direct capability class. If an authoritatively specified assemblage is sufficient and only its P/T-dependent physical properties are needed, BurnMan may provide the simpler Python integration. ARCANA's need for phase-equilibrium petrology has not been established.
